name: battery-display
title: Battery Display
summary: Test patch: the percentage inside the battery icon
description: The battery icon stays. Below 100 %, the percentage shows inside it. At 100 %, the iPod shows the Apple picture of a full battery. The patch can also use a curve from a larger battery in place of the Apple table.
details: At 100 %, the iPod shows only the Apple picture of a full battery. Below 100 %, the percentage shows inside the icon.
The text is black, bold and centred in the middle of the battery icon. It uses the Pixo font, size 7, which stock screens of the iPod use for small texts.
The icon is light in the Apple look, in Classic Dark and in Dark Gray, so the black text is easy to read in each look. The icon pictures are the Apple pictures, with no change.
During a charge, the iPod shows the Apple charge icon with no percentage. The voltage is too high during a charge.
The Apple data moves in steps of 5 %. The Apple icon has only 16 levels.
Custom Battery changes the battery picture and the percentage. It does not change when the iPod stops.
Battery Curve imports a battery log, so that you can make a curve for your own battery.
notes: The built-in Custom Battery curve is provisional. It comes from one larger battery and is not from a full charge. Import a log for your own battery.

The patch also sets the flag byte + 92 of the text element to 0. A text with the flag 0x0c is white in the dark looks, and a text with the flag 0 is black. The switch table of Switch on iPod does not change the bytes that a patch changes.
The patch changes 5 values in each of the Views 25598 and 25599: the 4 edges of the text box and the Type of the battery text. It changes no font record.
The iPod has no Podium Sans font smaller than size 14. Version 0.5 used a Podium Sans Type of size 9, and the iPod restarted at the Apple logo.
A theme that changes these bytes can stop the build. The build then shows an error with the bytes that it found.

choices.title: Icon + Percent
choices.description: The battery icon, with the percentage inside it.

choices.title: Apple
choices.description: The Apple table. Use this for a battery of the original size.

choices.title: Custom Battery
choices.description: A curve from a larger battery. It changes the icon and the percentage.
choices.caution: The curve is provisional. It is for one battery, and other batteries are different.

choices.title: Off
choices.description: The percentage follows the data directly. Apple data moves in steps of 5 %.

choices.title: On
choices.description: A longer average, and no small rises. Apple data moves in steps of 1 %, but it is then not the exact Apple logic. The value changes more slowly, and it can stay still for some minutes.
